memo: MEMO: Yesterday the account fell from $1,000 to $960.69 (-3.9%), while Bitcoin held at $984.27 and SPY at $999.08, so the basket trailed both benchmarks. Three suggestions: /  / 1. Reduce churn. Three sell-and-replace cycles on 25 August each paid roughly 0.10% in costs and swapped out holdings that were still underwater. Sell only when a holding is clearly above break-even, by at least 1%, and avoid replacing it immediately. /  / 2. Tighten the dip rule. The ten buys went into a broad coin selloff (top 10 coins -3.0% over 24 hours), and most are still below cost. Require a dip of at least 3% below the 24-hour average, plus a steadying move over the last 6 hours, before buying. /  / 3. Favour SPY exposure when the US market reopens, since it held up better than the coin basket.

MEMO: The account rose from $975.68 to $987.55 since the 08-26 05:00 meeting, with Bitcoin at $990.53 and SPY at $999.30 on the last record. Require a set margin below the 24-hour average before any buy, and avoid chasing coins like SPX28081, up 11.7% in six hours. / 3. **Verify the ten-holding rule.** The record lists only Bitcoin and SPY. Confirm the account holds ten positions, and plan replacements for any sale. Stock orders resume at 13:30 UTC.
